Scene 04

FBI HEADQUARTERS

Fox Mulder

You wanted to see me, sir?

Walter Skinner

Yeah, sit down. Two weeks ago, a woman named Martha Crittendon... Disappeared from her home in bethany, vermont. Local police haven't turned up any sign of her. I'm hoping you may be able to.

Fox Mulder

I'm already on a case.

Walter Skinner

You're on a stakeout. I'm confident agent Scully can continue in your absence.

Fox Mulder

Why? What did I do?

Walter Skinner

There may be aspects to this that... Speak to your strengths as an investigator.

Fox Mulder

Specifically?

Walter Skinner

Ravens. What do you know about 'em-- their mythological or paranormal significance?

Fox Mulder

Well, the, uh-- the raven is considered a very powerful symbol... In certain norse, celtic and native-American cultures. Mostly a negative one. Indians view it as a deceiving spirit. Christianity mostly associates it with evil. And then, of course, there's poe's raven... And nevermore and all that stuff.

Walter Skinner

Martha Crittendon's seven-year-old daughter... Claimed she was attacked by a raven earlier the day her mother disappeared. Later, she heard one inside the house before she discovered her mother was missing.

Fox Mulder

No, really, what did I do?

Walter Skinner

It's the only lead that hasn't been explored. I wanna know if it has any bearing on the case.

Fox Mulder

I'm also assuming that the fact that Martha Crittendon's father... Is a federal judge also has a little bearing on this case?

Walter Skinner

It's been made clear to me that locating her is my top priority. I'm making it yours as well.

[ car approaching ]
